blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-bad-6"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "30m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
timezone = "America/New_York"
clock = "frozen:2026-03-14T09:00:00"

diagnostics.message: [sandbox] clock is a table { start, advance, enforce }: write [sandbox] clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00-04:00", advance = "none", enforce = "world" }, which is what "frozen:2026-03-14T09:00:00" meant, and set network = "none" for the agent's phase, which a clock requires
